# I Do by Marisa

> Story-first wedding officiant based in Metro Detroit, Michigan, available nationwide. Marisa writes and officiates custom ceremonies built around each couple's real story. Tagline: "Story is the signature."

## Services
- The Signature Ceremony: a custom ceremony written from scratch and officiated with warmth, humor and heart.
- Script-Only Ceremonies: a fully written ceremony script for when a friend or family member is officiating.
- Officiant Coaching: one-on-one guidance for anyone speaking at or officiating a ceremony.
- Vow Writing Support: guided resources and 1:1 help to write vows that sound like you.
- Inquire: https://idobymarisa.com/#connect

## Shop (digital products, coming soon to Etsy; free downloads available now)
- The Vow Vault ($9): vow templates and inspiration in different tones.
- Promise Pages ($18): a guided vow-writing workbook.
- The Wedding Party Collection ($16): inclusive proposal cards for every role, in 3 colors, with 8 envelope liners.
- The Thank-You Collection ($16): thank-you cards for the wedding party, family, officiant and vendors.
- The Story-First Officiant Kit ($29): everything a first-time officiant needs to write and lead a ceremony.
- The Ceremony Bundle ($45): the Kit, the Vow Vault and Promise Pages together.
- The Vow Builder ($19) and The Toast Builder ($19): guided writing tools for vows and wedding toasts.
- Shop: https://idobymarisa.com/the-shop

Every guest gets a favor, and you came all this way.
- One (1) slice of virtual wedding cake. Vanilla, obviously.

Thank you for coming. Story is the signature.
